cohort: 21,648 women who underwent frozen single-blastocyst transfer
finding: Hormone replacement cycles for endometrium preparation are associated with an increased risk of preterm delivery, very preterm delivery, cesarean delivery, low birth weight, macrosomia, premature rupture of membrane, and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, while stimulated cycles are associated with an increased risk of postterm delivery and gestational diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: Hormone replacement cycles were associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
